title: Spring WebFlux Router Function Configuration
description: JSON Schema representing the structure of a Spring WebFlux RouterFunction route configuration, describing functional endpoints.

routes.description: List of route definitions composed into a RouterFunction

path.description: URI path pattern (supports template variables like {id})

handler.description: Handler function bean name or class reference

filters.description: List of handler filter functions applied to this route

attributes.description: Custom attributes on the route for documentation or metadata

basePath.description: Common base path prefix for all routes in this router

filters.description: Global filters applied to all routes in this router
